newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold closes at day's low in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: HK gold closes at day's low in cautious trade.

text.p: Hong Kong gold extended early losses to close at its day's low, despite a rebound in New York overnight, and dealers said trading was quiet and narrow range.
Bullion ended at US$339.50/340.00 an ounce against New York's US$340.20/70 close on Thursday.

"There was a lack of trading interest in the local market, which kept trade hemmed in a 40 U.S. cent range all day," a local trading house dealer said. "Players are cautious and don't want big speculative positions without a clear market trend."
"Most traders are monitoring the U.S. dollar movements in the short term and watching whether the price of gold holds at US$339-340 support levels or not," another dealer said.
Local gold ended unchanged at HK$3,143 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged at -8.00.
